reviews.finding: Full loop verified with real input; arrows unverifiable in their session, win leg not completed by them, keydown handler threw on synthetic window-targeted events.
reviews.fix: Arrow path shares code with WASD (verified panning live); victory completed by the scripted skirmish playtest (147s); keydown guarded with instanceof Element.
reviews.verdict: All three critic findings addressed; no blocking gaps remain.

reviews.finding: Stronghold lacked fortress presence; mid-field empty of landmarks; HUD crowds small viewports.
reviews.fix: Stronghold model scaled 1.22x (screenshot verified); three rock-spire landmarks placed off-corridor (screenshot verified); HUD crowding noted as acceptable, onboarding now auto-dismisses on first order.
reviews.verdict: Both P1 visual gaps corrected and visually confirmed.

reviews.finding: H hotkey trapped after minimap use; single-click pick too strict; onboarding persisted; arrows blocked while buttons focused.
reviews.fix: HUD key isolation now only owns minimap-navigation and button-activation keys (H/arrows verified working live); 30px forgiving pick capsule for select/attack/gather (verified); onboarding dismisses on first successful order (verified); mode chip made click-through (verified CANVAS hit).
reviews.verdict: All functional HUD gaps fixed and re-verified in the running game.

method: Browser playtests use real DOM/canvas input. game.update advances unchanged simulation rules to shorten waits — no resources granted, no stats changed, no outcomes forced. Defeat verified by leaving the settlement unattended against escalating raids. Critics used independent browser sessions and their own screenshots.
renderer: Three.js WebGL; Chromium / SwiftShader CPU software rendering for browser verification
